SELECT l.LIFE_ID AS lifeId, l.NAME AS name, l.GENDER AS gender, l.BIRTH_COUNTRY AS birthCountry, bc.NAME_KO AS countryName, (SELECT h.HIST_NAME FROM COUNTRY_NAME_HIST h WHERE h.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY AND h.START_YEAR <= l.BIRTH_YEAR AND (h.END_YEAR IS NULL OR h.END_YEAR >= l.BIRTH_YEAR) AND ROWNUM = 1) AS histName, l.CURRENT_COUNTRY AS currentCountry, cc.NAME_KO AS currentCountryName, l.BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, l.DEATH_AGE AS deathAge, l.BIRTH_YEAR + l.DEATH_AGE AS deathYear, l.DEATH_CAUSE AS deathCause, (SELECT s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM COUNTRY_STAT s WHERE s.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY AND s.DECADE = TRUNC(l.BIRTH_YEAR / 10) * 10) AS lifeExpectancy, l.EDU_LEVEL AS eduLevel, l.SCHOOL_STATUS AS schoolStatus, l.JOB_ID AS jobId, j.JOB_NAME AS jobName, l.JOB_STATUS AS jobStatus, l.AVG_INCOME AS avgIncome, l.INCOME_TOP_PCT AS incomeTopPct, l.LIFE_SCORE AS lifeScore, ROUND(l.HEALTH) AS health, ROUND(l.HAPPINESS) AS happiness, ROUND(l.KNOWLEDGE) AS knowledge, ROUND(l.RELATION) AS relation, l.IS_MARRIED AS marriedYn,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG g WHERE g.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID AND g.LOG_TEXT LIKE '%결혼식을 올렸%') AS weddingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG g WHERE g.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID AND (g.LOG_TEXT LIKE '%각자의 길을 가기로%' OR g.LOG_TEXT LIKE '%이혼했%')) AS divorceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG g WHERE g.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID AND g.LOG_TEXT LIKE '%배우자를 먼저 떠나보내%') AS widowCount, l.CHILD_COUNT AS childCount, l.START_TYPE AS startType, l.STATUS AS status, (SELECT m.POST_ID FROM MEMORIAL_POST m WHERE m.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID) AS memorialPostId FROM LIFE l JOIN COUNTRY bc ON bc.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY JOIN COUNTRY cc ON cc.COUNTRY_CODE = l.CURRENT_COUNTRY LEFT JOIN JOB j ON j.JOB_ID = l.JOB_ID WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}

SELECT y.AGE AS age, y.YEAR_NO AS yearNo, y.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, y.HEALTH AS health, y.HAPPINESS AS happiness, y.KNOWLEDGE AS knowledge, y.RELATION AS relation, y.EDU_LEVEL AS eduLevel, j.JOB_NAME AS jobName, y.INCOME AS income, y.ASSETS AS assets, y.FOCUS_CODE AS focusCode FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG y LEFT JOIN JOB j ON j.JOB_ID = y.JOB_ID WHERE y.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY y.AGE

SELECT e.LOG_ID AS logId, e.AGE AS age, e.YEAR_NO AS yearNo, e.EVENT_ID AS eventId, c.CHOICE_TEXT AS choiceText, e.LOG_TEXT AS logText, e.IS_AI AS isAi FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG e LEFT JOIN EVENT_CHOICE c ON c.CHOICE_ID = e.CHOICE_ID WHERE e.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY e.AGE, e.LOG_ID

SELECT q.QUEST_ID AS questId, q.QUEST_NAME AS questName, q.DESCRIPTION AS description, lq.ACHIEVED AS achieved, lq.POINT_GIVEN AS pointGiven FROM LIFE_QUEST lq JOIN QUEST q ON q.QUEST_ID = lq.QUEST_ID WHERE lq.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY q.QUEST_ID
SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM POINT_HISTORY WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND REASON = 'QUEST'
